items.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: square fantasy feat illustration for a tabletop character builder.
Primary request: original narrative artwork for the feat Cryokinesis.
Subject: one clearly identifiable main character, female goliath, an experienced adult in their thirties. Anatomically appropriate ancestry; retain unmistakable nonhuman features where relevant. Fully clothed practical fantasy attire suitable to this specific ability. Other people only when needed to depict the feat, and always adults.
Scene direction: An adventurer demonstrating Cryokinesis in a concrete story moment. Read the feat details below and choose the single most distinctive visual action or effect. Make the character genuinely perform that ability with appropriate tools or body movement.
Suggested setting and clothing palette: a stormy coastal cliff, indigo and silver clothing. Adapt setting and attire when the depicted ability requires another environment; avoid repeating the same purple robe, identical casting pose or ruined arch across the set.
Feat reference details (context, never printed in the image):
*Wild Talent Feat (Prerequisite: Can’t Have Another Wild Talent Feat)*

You gain the following benefits.

**Ice Manipulation.** Once per turn when you cast a spell or hit with an attack roll and deal Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, or Psychic damage, you can change the damage type to Cold damage.

**Psionic Talent.** You know the *Ray of Frost* cantrip. You also always have the *Armor of Agathys* and *Ice Knife* spells prepared. You can cast each spell once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast these spells using any spell slots you have. When you cast these spells, they require no Verbal or Material components, and Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for them (choose when you select this feat).
Style/medium: lush painterly high fantasy illustration, visible soft brush texture, rich atmospheric depth, tactile materials, expressive faces, dramatic cinematic natural and magical light. Match the established spell and trait illustrations: polished narrative fantasy book art, colorful magical accents grounded in deep shadows, detailed but visually readable. This is a full scene, not a tiny flat icon.
Composition: square edge-to-edge painting with one strong focal action; medium or wide framing showing enough environment to explain the ability. Keep head, hands and essential props inside safe margins. Vary the viewpoint according to the action. Explicitly depict this feat's distinguishing ability rather than generic spellcasting.
Constraints: no titles, no text, no readable writing, no letters, no numbers, no UI, no stats, no logos, no watermark, no decorative frame, no collage, no panels. No nudity, no gore, no open wounds, no body horror. If a feat concerns death or injury, express it through symbolic magical light, protective gestures or a non-graphic scene. Original fantasy art.
